rationale: Performance marketers running Google App campaigns face recurring, financially costly attribution gaps every time they attempt to upload GBRAID-only offline conversions — the legacy uploader rejects them outright, corrupting bidding signals on active ad spend. Multiple corroborating threads across Google Ads Help, Stack Overflow, and PPC communities confirm this is a documented, unsolved platform gap affecting agencies and in-house teams alike, with at least one competitor charging for adjacent Google Ads API tooling. Willingness to pay is structurally strong: buyers already spend thousands per month on Google Ads and will pay to protect attribution integrity.
